blocks.zh: Annex II: Potential Applications for Quality Risk Management｜附錄二：品質風險管理的潛在應用領域
blocks.en: Annex II: Potential Applications for Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 QRM 在 9 大應用領域中的具體用途，掌握 Annex II 作為「實踐工具箱」的功能定位
blocks.en: Understand the specific uses of QRM across the nine application areas, and see Annex II as a "practical toolbox"

blocks.zh: 理解 II.2 法規稽查（Regulatory Operations）如何以風險為基礎規劃查廠頻率與審查深度
blocks.en: Understand how II.2 Regulatory Operations uses risk to plan inspection frequency and the depth of review

blocks.zh: 掌握 II.4 廠房設備公用系統中 QRM 如何驅動設計、確效、清潔驗證等決策
blocks.en: Understand how QRM drives design, qualification and cleaning validation decisions under II.4 Facilities, Equipment and Utilities

blocks.zh: 理解 II.9 供應鏈控制（Supply Chain Control）作為 Q9(R1) 新增章節的核心意義，與後疫情時代供應鏈韌性的關聯
blocks.en: Understand the significance of II.9 Supply Chain Control, the key new section in Q9(R1), and its link to supply chain resilience in the post-pandemic era

blocks.zh: 能夠選擇適當的 QRM 工具（來自 Annex I）應用於各領域情境
blocks.en: Be able to select appropriate QRM tools (from Annex I) for scenarios in each area

blocks.zh: 認識 CDMO 在 II.5（物料管理）、II.6（生產）、II.9（供應鏈）三個領域中的特殊角色與責任
blocks.en: Recognize the particular role and responsibilities of a CDMO in three areas: II.5 (Materials Management), II.6 (Production) and II.9 (Supply Chain)

blocks.zh: Annex II 總覽｜9 大應用領域概觀
blocks.en: Annex II Overview: The Nine Application Areas

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Note
blocks.en: Key Note

blocks.zh: Annex II 是「應用示例」而非「強制要求」。原文特別指出："This Annex is not intended to create any new expectations beyond the current regulatory requirements."
blocks.en: Annex II provides "application examples", not "mandatory requirements". The original text states explicitly: "This Annex is not intended to create any new expectations beyond the current regulatory requirements."

blocks.zh: 其意義在於：法規機關和業界共同認可 QRM 在這些領域的應用是最佳實務（best practice），但工具的選擇仍取決於具體情境。
blocks.en: What this means is that regulators and industry jointly recognize the use of QRM in these areas as best practice, but the choice of tools still depends on the specific situation.

blocks.zh: II.1 & II.2 — Integrated Quality Management & Regulatory Operations｜整合性品質管理與法規作業
blocks.en: II.1 & II.2 — Integrated Quality Management & Regulatory Operations

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.1 整合性品質管理
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.1 Integrated Quality Management

blocks.zh: II.1 涵蓋了整個品質系統的日常運作。可以把它理解為：品質系統的每一個決策節點，都應有 QRM 作為依據。
blocks.en: II.1 covers the day-to-day operation of the whole quality system. Think of it this way: every decision point in the quality system should be backed by QRM.

blocks.zh: 文件（Documentation）：用 QRM 決定哪些流程需要 SOP、SOP 的詳細程度。高風險操作需要更嚴格的文件控制。
blocks.en: Documentation: use QRM to decide which processes need an SOP and how detailed the SOP should be. High-risk operations need tighter document control.

blocks.zh: 培訓（Training）：不是所有人都需要同樣的培訓。QRM 幫助識別哪些操作對品質影響最大，聚焦培訓資源。
blocks.en: Training: not everyone needs the same training. QRM helps identify which operations have the greatest impact on quality, so training resources can be focused.

blocks.zh: 品質缺陷（Quality Defects）：偏差、OOS、投訴——QRM 提供評估這些事件嚴重性的系統化方法（可用 FMEA 的 Severity 評分）。
blocks.en: Quality Defects: deviations, OOS results and complaints. QRM provides a systematic way to assess how serious these events are (for example, the Severity score in FMEA).

blocks.zh: 稽核（Auditing）：稽核頻率和範圍應根據風險而定，ICH Q9 明確列出 11 項影響稽核決策的因素（見原文）。
blocks.en: Auditing: audit frequency and scope should be set according to risk. ICH Q9 lists 11 factors that influence audit decisions (see the original text).

blocks.zh: 變更控制（Change Control）：QRM 評估變更的影響，決定需要做哪些重新確效或重新驗證。這直接影響資源投入的多寡。
blocks.en: Change Control: QRM assesses the impact of a change and determines what re-qualification or re-validation is needed. This directly affects how many resources are committed.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.2 法規作業（Regulatory Operations）
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.2 Regulatory Operations

blocks.zh: II.2 是 QRM 在法規機關側的應用——這是從監管者（FDA、EMA、PMDA 等）的視角來使用 QRM。
blocks.en: II.2 is the application of QRM on the regulator's side, that is, using QRM from the perspective of the regulators (FDA, EMA, PMDA and others).

blocks.zh: 風險導向查廠（Risk-Based Inspections）：法規機關不可能查所有廠，所以他們根據 II.1 稽核章節中的因素來規劃查哪些廠、查多深。高風險廠（如有多次召回記錄、製程複雜的無菌製劑廠）查廠頻率更高、範圍更廣。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Inspections: regulators cannot inspect every site, so they use the factors in the II.1 auditing section to plan which sites to inspect and how deeply. High-risk sites (for example, those with a recall history or complex sterile manufacturing processes) are inspected more often and more broadly.

blocks.zh: 送審文件評估（Dossier Evaluation）：審查員用科學的風險評估方法來評估申請文件的合理性。Q8 + Q9 結合的送審文件（有 Design Space、CQA 分析）可以得到更快、更有把握的審查結論。
blocks.en: Dossier Evaluation: assessors use scientific risk assessment methods to judge the soundness of an application. A submission that combines Q8 and Q9 (with a Design Space and CQA analysis) can reach a faster and more confident review conclusion.

blocks.zh: 查廠員與審查員的溝通：查廠員（Inspector）和文件審查員（Assessor）應共享風險資訊，確保對 PAT、參數放行等新技術的理解一致。
blocks.en: Communication between inspectors and assessors: inspectors and dossier assessors should share risk information so that their understanding of new technologies such as PAT and parametric release is consistent.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：法規機關如何使用 QRM
blocks.en: Analogy: How Regulators Use QRM

blocks.zh: 把法規機關的查廠計畫想像成警察局的巡邏排班：警力有限，所以巡邏頻率取決於該區域的犯罪風險評估（治安歷史、人口密度、時段）。藥廠也一樣——如果一家廠歷史記錄良好、QRM 體系健全、製程相對簡單，法規機關可能 5 年才查一次；反之，有召回記錄、生產高風險產品的廠可能每年都要查。
blocks.en: Think of a regulator's inspection plan as a police patrol schedule: with limited officers, patrol frequency depends on the assessed crime risk of each area (crime history, population density, time of day). Pharmaceutical sites work the same way. A site with a good track record, a sound QRM system and a relatively simple process may be inspected only once every five years. A site with recalls or high-risk products may be inspected every year.

blocks.zh: 這也意味著：建立強健的 QRM 體系，不只是做對事，還能降低被查廠的頻率——這是具體可量化的商業價值。
blocks.en: This also means that building a robust QRM system is not only the right thing to do, it can also reduce how often you are inspected, which is a concrete, measurable business benefit.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：變更控制中的 QRM 分類
blocks.en: Key Note: QRM Classification in Change Control

blocks.zh: 在實務中，QRM 最常用於變更控制的影響評估，以決定變更類別：
blocks.en: In practice, QRM is most often used in the impact assessment of change control to decide the change category:

blocks.zh: 重大變更（Major Change）：高風險影響 → 需 Prior Approval Supplement（PAS）
blocks.en: Major Change: high-risk impact, requires a Prior Approval Supplement (PAS)

blocks.zh: 中度變更（Moderate Change）：中風險 → CBE-30（Changes Being Effected in 30 days）
blocks.en: Moderate Change: medium risk, CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected in 30 days)

blocks.zh: 微小變更（Minor Change）：低風險 → Annual Report 即可
blocks.en: Minor Change: low risk, an Annual Report is sufficient

blocks.zh: QRM 提供分類的科學依據，讓廠商和法規機關都認可這個分類是有理由的，而不是主觀判斷。
blocks.en: QRM provides the scientific basis for the classification, so that both the company and the regulator accept that the category is justified rather than a subjective judgment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，II.1 的稽核（Auditing）章節特別重要：客戶（品牌藥廠）定期稽核 CDMO 的頻率，正是依據這 11 項風險因素決定的。CDMO 若能展示：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the Auditing part of II.1 is especially important: the frequency with which clients (brand-owner companies) audit a CDMO is determined by exactly these 11 risk factors. If a CDMO can demonstrate:

blocks.zh: 強健的 QRM 體系（Robustness of QRM activities）
blocks.en: A robust QRM system (Robustness of QRM activities)

blocks.zh: 良好的歷史合規記錄（Compliance history）
blocks.en: A good compliance history (Compliance history)

blocks.zh: 低缺陷率（Low number/significance of quality defects）
blocks.en: A low number and significance of quality defects (Low number/significance of quality defects)

blocks.zh: 則客戶可能降低稽核頻率，從每年一次降為每 18 個月一次，節省雙方的資源。這也是 CDMO 業務開發中的重要競爭力指標。
blocks.en: then clients may reduce audit frequency, for example from once a year to once every 18 months, saving resources on both sides. This is also an important competitive indicator in CDMO business development.

blocks.zh: II.3 & II.4 — Development & Facilities, Equipment and Utilities｜開發與廠房、設備、公用系統
blocks.en: II.3 & II.4 — Development & Facilities, Equipment and Utilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.3 開發中的 QRM
blocks.en: Core Concepts: QRM in II.3 Development

blocks.zh: II.3 是 Q9 與 Q8（Pharmaceutical Development）最緊密連結的地方。在開發過程中，QRM 有三個核心功能：
blocks.en: II.3 is where Q9 connects most closely with Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development). During development, QRM has three core functions:

blocks.zh: 識別 CQA（Critical Quality Attributes）：用 QRM 評估哪些品質屬性（如溶出度、含量均勻性、無菌性）對病患安全最關鍵——這是風險評估的 Severity 維度。
blocks.en: Identify CQAs (Critical Quality Attributes): use QRM to assess which quality attributes (such as dissolution, content uniformity and sterility) are most critical to patient safety. This is the Severity dimension of risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 連結 CQA 與 CPP/CMA：透過風險評估矩陣，找出哪些製程參數（CPP）和物料屬性（CMA）會影響 CQA，集中開發資源做 DOE。
blocks.en: Link CQAs to CPPs/CMAs: use a risk assessment matrix to find which process parameters (CPPs) and material attributes (CMAs) affect the CQAs, and focus development resources on DOE for those.

blocks.zh: 支持 Design Space 建立：QRM 告訴你「哪些參數組合最值得研究」，節省開發時間和成本。
blocks.en: Support Design Space establishment: QRM tells you "which parameter combinations are most worth studying", saving development time and cost.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.4 廠房設備公用系統
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.4 Facilities, Equipment and Utilities

blocks.zh: II.4 展示 QRM 在工程和確效領域的應用，主要回答這三個問題：
blocks.en: II.4 shows how QRM applies in engineering and qualification. It mainly answers three questions:

blocks.zh: 設計時：廠房分區如何劃分？哪些設備需要封閉式設計？隔離技術（isolator）vs 潔淨室哪個風險更低？
blocks.en: At design: how should the facility be zoned? Which equipment needs a closed design? Which carries lower risk, an isolator or a cleanroom?

blocks.zh: 確效時：IQ/OQ/PQ 的範圍要多廣？哪些儀器設備需要完整確效，哪些只需簡化確效？
blocks.en: At qualification: how broad should the IQ/OQ/PQ scope be? Which instruments and equipment need full qualification and which need only a simplified one?

blocks.zh: 日常運作：清潔驗證的可接受限度如何設定？校驗週期多長合適？
blocks.en: In routine operation: how should acceptance limits for cleaning validation be set? What calibration interval is appropriate?

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：廠房設計中的 QRM 思考
blocks.en: Analogy: QRM Thinking in Facility Design

blocks.zh: 設計無菌製劑廠房時面臨一個經典問題：用傳統 RABS（受限進出隔離系統）還是 Isolator？
blocks.en: When designing a sterile manufacturing facility, a classic question arises: use a conventional RABS (Restricted Access Barrier System) or an isolator?

blocks.zh: QRM 的思考框架：
blocks.en: The QRM way of thinking:

blocks.zh: 風險識別：哪種技術在正常/異常操作下，微生物污染的概率更低？
blocks.en: Risk identification: under normal and abnormal operation, which technology has the lower probability of microbial contamination?

blocks.zh: 風險評估：Isolator 的無菌保證水準（Sterility Assurance Level）更高，但去污染（VHP 滅菌）失敗的影響也更大
blocks.en: Risk assessment: an isolator offers a higher Sterility Assurance Level, but the consequence of a failed decontamination (VHP) cycle is also greater

blocks.zh: 風險控制：兩種方案各需要什麼監控和驗證？
blocks.en: Risk control: what monitoring and validation does each option require?

blocks.zh: 決策：根據產品特性（凍乾 vs 液體注射劑）、生產規模、人員技能水準，選擇最適合的方案
blocks.en: Decision: choose the most suitable option based on product characteristics (lyophilized vs liquid injectable), production scale and the skill level of personnel

blocks.zh: 這個決策過程本身就是 QRM 的體現——而且要文件化，以證明選擇的合理性。
blocks.en: This decision-making process is itself QRM in action, and it must be documented to demonstrate that the choice is justified.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：確效範圍的風險決策（Risk-Based Qualification）
blocks.en: Key Note: Risk-Based Decisions on Qualification Scope (Risk-Based Qualification)

blocks.zh: QRM 在確效中最重要的應用是：並非所有設備都需要同等程度的 IQ/OQ/PQ。
blocks.en: The most important use of QRM in qualification is this: not all equipment needs the same level of IQ/OQ/PQ.

blocks.zh: 高風險設備（直接接觸產品、關鍵製程）：完整 IQ/OQ/PQ + 定期再確效
blocks.en: High-risk equipment (direct product contact, critical processes): full IQ/OQ/PQ plus periodic requalification

blocks.zh: 中風險設備（間接接觸、輔助系統）：IQ/OQ，PQ 可簡化
blocks.en: Medium-risk equipment (indirect contact, support systems): IQ/OQ, with PQ simplified

blocks.zh: 低風險設備（辦公室設備、一般倉庫）：可能只需 IQ 或設備日誌即可
blocks.en: Low-risk equipment (office equipment, general warehouse): IQ alone or an equipment logbook may be enough

blocks.zh: 這個分層確效策略（Risk-Based Qualification Strategy）是 ISPE GAMP 5 和 ICH Q9 共同推薦的做法，可以大幅節省確效資源。
blocks.en: This tiered qualification approach (Risk-Based Qualification Strategy) is recommended by both ISPE GAMP 5 and ICH Q9, and can save a great deal of qualification effort.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：清潔驗證限度的 QRM 依據
blocks.en: Key Note: QRM Basis for Cleaning Validation Limits

blocks.zh: 多產品廠房（Multi-Product Facility）的清潔驗證，最核心的問題是：殘留物的可接受限度是多少？
blocks.en: For cleaning validation in a multi-product facility, the central question is: what is the acceptable limit for residues?

blocks.zh: QRM 方法（依據 EMA 清潔驗證指南）：
blocks.en: The QRM approach (based on the EMA guidance on cleaning validation):

blocks.zh: 評估前一批次 API 的毒性（LD50、PDE 值）→ 確定健康暴露閾值
blocks.en: Assess the toxicity of the previous batch's API (LD50, PDE value) to determine the health-based exposure threshold

blocks.zh: 評估設備表面的共用程度 → 污染傳遞路徑的概率
blocks.en: Assess the degree of shared equipment surfaces to determine the probability of contamination transfer pathways

blocks.zh: 設定基於 Health-Based Exposure Limits (HBEL) 的科學限度，而非單純的「0.1% batch / 10 ppm」傳統標準
blocks.en: Set scientific limits based on Health-Based Exposure Limits (HBEL) rather than the traditional "0.1% of batch / 10 ppm" criteria alone

blocks.zh: II.3 對 CDMO 的意義：當客戶技術轉移時，若客戶已有 QRM 驅動的 CQA/CPP 文件（即 Q8 風格的開發包），CDMO 的技術轉移風險評估可以直接建立在這個基礎上，大幅縮短轉移時間。若客戶沒有，CDMO 需要自行補做——這是重要的收費服務項目。
blocks.en: What II.3 means for a CDMO: when a client transfers technology, if the client already has QRM-driven CQA/CPP documentation (that is, a Q8-style development package), the CDMO's technology transfer risk assessment can be built directly on it, greatly shortening the transfer time. If the client does not, the CDMO has to prepare it itself, which is an important chargeable service.

blocks.zh: II.4 對 CDMO 的意義：CDMO 廠房通常服務多個客戶、多種產品，清潔驗證（防止交叉污染）和設備共用風險是核心議題。完整的風險導向清潔驗證程序，是 CDMO 通過客戶稽核的必備條件。
blocks.en: What II.4 means for a CDMO: CDMO facilities usually serve several clients and many products, so cleaning validation (preventing cross-contamination) and shared-equipment risk are core issues. A complete risk-based cleaning validation program is a must-have for passing client audits.

blocks.zh: II.5 & II.6 — Materials Management & Production｜物料管理與生產
blocks.en: II.5 & II.6 — Materials Management & Production

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.5 物料管理
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.5 Materials Management

blocks.zh: 物料管理的 QRM 覆蓋從供應商選擇到原料入廠到儲運的完整鏈條：
blocks.en: QRM in materials management covers the full chain from supplier selection through receipt of raw materials to storage and distribution:

blocks.zh: 供應商評估：不是所有供應商都需要現場稽核。QRM 幫助決定哪些供應商需要 On-site Audit、哪些可以僅靠問卷（Questionnaire）或文件審查（Document Review）。
blocks.en: Supplier evaluation: not every supplier needs an on-site audit. QRM helps decide which suppliers need an On-site Audit and which can be handled with a Questionnaire or Document Review alone.

blocks.zh: 起始原料變異性：同一 API 不同批次的合成路徑（route of synthesis）、雜質概況（impurity profile）可能不同。QRM 評估這種變異性對最終成品的影響有多大。
blocks.en: Variability of starting materials: different batches of the same API may differ in route of synthesis and impurity profile. QRM assesses how much this variability affects the finished product.

blocks.zh: 隔離物料使用：QC 尚未放行的物料能否先進行下一步加工？QRM 評估這樣做的風險與時間節省的效益。
blocks.en: Use of quarantined materials: can material not yet released by QC go on to the next processing step? QRM weighs the risk of doing so against the time saved.

blocks.zh: 冷鏈管理：溫敏藥品（如生物製劑、疫苗）的儲運溫度偏差，需要 QRM 評估對產品品質的實際影響，而不是自動報廢。
blocks.en: Cold chain management: for temperature-sensitive products (such as biologics and vaccines), a temperature excursion in storage or transport needs a QRM assessment of its actual effect on product quality, rather than automatic rejection.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.6 生產中的 QRM
blocks.en: Core Concepts: QRM in II.6 Production

blocks.zh: 驗證範圍：製程有幾十個步驟，不可能每步都做完整驗證。QRM 識別哪些是關鍵步驟（critical steps），集中驗證資源。
blocks.en: Validation scope: a process has dozens of steps, and it is not possible to validate every step fully. QRM identifies the critical steps so that validation resources can be concentrated.

blocks.zh: 製程內管控頻率：取樣頻率（如每小時 vs 每 30 分鐘）的決策應基於風險——過少取樣風險高，過多取樣浪費資源且可能影響製程。
blocks.en: In-process control frequency: decisions on sampling frequency (for example, hourly vs every 30 minutes) should be based on risk. Too little sampling means high risk, while too much wastes resources and may even affect the process.

blocks.zh: PAT 導入：引入近紅外光（NIR）等 PAT 工具做即時含量監測，需要 QRM 評估這種方法的準確性和失效風險，才能向法規機關說明其可靠性。
blocks.en: PAT implementation: introducing PAT tools such as near-infrared (NIR) for real-time content monitoring requires QRM to assess the accuracy and failure risk of the method, so that its reliability can be explained to regulators.

blocks.zh: 生產排程：多產品廠房的生產順序（是否 Campaign）需要 QRM 評估交叉污染風險，以決定清潔週期和生產間隔。
blocks.en: Production scheduling: in a multi-product facility, the production sequence (whether to run campaigns) needs a QRM assessment of cross-contamination risk to determine cleaning cycles and intervals between productions.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：供應商分級管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Tiered Supplier Management

blocks.zh: 想像你經營一家供應鏈複雜的公司（如汽車廠），你不可能對每一個零件供應商都做同等密度的管理。你的策略是：
blocks.en: Imagine you run a company with a complex supply chain (such as a car maker). You cannot manage every parts supplier with the same intensity. Your strategy is:

blocks.zh: Tier 1（關鍵供應商）：供應核心零件、單一來源、無替代 → 年度現場稽核 + 即時資料共享
blocks.en: Tier 1 (critical suppliers): supply core parts, single source, no alternative. Annual on-site audit plus real-time data sharing

blocks.zh: Tier 2（重要供應商）：有替代來源、品質記錄良好 → 每 2-3 年稽核一次 + 定期問卷
blocks.en: Tier 2 (important suppliers): have alternative sources and a good quality record. Audit every 2-3 years plus a periodic questionnaire

blocks.zh: Tier 3（一般供應商）：標準物料、市場上多家可替代 → 文件審查即可
blocks.en: Tier 3 (general suppliers): standard materials with many substitutes on the market. Document review is enough

blocks.zh: 藥廠的供應商管理也應如此——QRM 提供分級的科學依據，避免對所有供應商一視同仁的「過度管理」或「管理不足」。
blocks.en: Supplier management in a pharmaceutical company should work the same way. QRM provides the scientific basis for tiering, avoiding both "over-management" and "under-management" caused by treating all suppliers alike.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：製程驗證的風險導向設計
blocks.en: Key Note: Risk-Based Design of Process Validation

blocks.zh: 傳統驗證思維：「做 3 批，批批合格，就算驗證通過」。
blocks.en: The traditional validation mindset: "Run 3 batches, and if every batch passes, validation is complete."

blocks.zh: 風險導向驗證思維（ICH Q9 + Q10 + FDA Process Validation 2011）：
blocks.en: The risk-based validation mindset (ICH Q9 + Q10 + FDA Process Validation Guidance 2011):

blocks.zh: 階段一（工藝設計，Process Design）：用 QRM 識別哪些參數是 CPP，需要重點研究
blocks.en: Stage 1 (Process Design): use QRM to identify which parameters are CPPs and need focused study

blocks.zh: 階段二（製程確認，Process Qualification）：驗證批次數量根據風險決定；高風險製程需要更多批次、更廣的取樣計畫
blocks.en: Stage 2 (Process Qualification): the number of validation batches is decided by risk. High-risk processes need more batches and a broader sampling plan

blocks.zh: 階段三（持續製程驗證，Continued Process Verification）：監控的頻率和指標由 QRM 決定，確保製程始終處於受控狀態
blocks.en: Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification): the monitoring frequency and indicators are decided by QRM, to ensure the process remains in a state of control

blocks.zh: CDMO 在 II.5 和 II.6 承擔雙重角色：
blocks.en: A CDMO carries a dual role in II.5 and II.6:

blocks.zh: 作為委託製造方（Contract Manufacturer）：CDMO 本身是客戶供應鏈中的一環，受 II.5 規範（客戶要稽核 CDMO）
blocks.en: As a contract manufacturer: the CDMO is itself a link in the client's supply chain and falls under II.5 (the client audits the CDMO)

blocks.zh: 作為採購方：CDMO 也需管理自己的原料供應商（API 原料藥供應商、輔料商），用 II.5 的方法做分級評估
blocks.en: As a purchaser: the CDMO must also manage its own raw material suppliers (API suppliers and excipient suppliers), using the II.5 approach for tiered evaluation

blocks.zh: 在 II.6 生產方面，CDMO 的驗證策略需要平台化——建立跨產品適用的風險評估模板，讓每個新品的驗證決策更快速、更一致。這是 CDMO 技術競爭力的核心之一。
blocks.en: In II.6 (production), a CDMO's validation strategy needs to be platform-based: build risk assessment templates that apply across products, so that validation decisions for each new product are faster and more consistent. This is one of the core elements of a CDMO's technical competitiveness.

blocks.zh: II.7, II.8 & II.9 — Lab/Stability, Packaging/Labeling & Supply Chain Control｜實驗室管制、包裝標籤與供應鏈控制
blocks.en: II.7, II.8 & II.9 — Lab/Stability, Packaging/Labeling & Supply Chain Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.7 實驗室管制與穩定性
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.7 Laboratory Controls and Stability

blocks.zh: OOS 調查中的 QRM：當分析結果超出規格（Out of Specification），QRM（特別是 Ishikawa 魚骨圖 + FMEA）用於系統性識別根本原因是實驗室錯誤（Phase I）還是製程問題（Phase II）。避免因調查邏輯不嚴謹而導致「廢棄數據但問題未解」的 FDA 483 觀察。
blocks.en: QRM in OOS investigations: when an analytical result is out of specification, QRM (in particular an Ishikawa diagram plus FMEA) is used to systematically identify whether the root cause is a laboratory error (Phase I) or a process problem (Phase II). This avoids an FDA 483 observation for "data invalidated but problem unresolved" caused by weak investigation logic.

blocks.zh: 複驗期/有效期的科學依據：ICH Q1A 要求的穩定性試驗設計（溫度條件、取樣時間點）本身就是 QRM 的應用——根據產品的預計降解風險，決定需要多少數據才能支持聲稱的有效期。
blocks.en: Scientific basis for retest period/shelf life: the stability study design required by ICH Q1A (storage conditions, sampling time points) is itself an application of QRM. Based on the product's expected degradation risk, it decides how much data is needed to support the claimed shelf life.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.8 包裝與標籤
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.8 Packaging and Labeling

blocks.zh: 容器封閉系統（CCS）選擇：QRM 評估不同 CCS 方案（玻璃瓶 vs 塑膠瓶、橡皮塞材質）對藥品相容性、藥物吸附、氧氣透過率的影響，以及患者用藥安全的風險。
blocks.en: Container closure system (CCS) selection: QRM assesses how different CCS options (glass vs plastic vials, stopper materials) affect drug compatibility, adsorption and oxygen transmission, as well as the risk to patient safety.

blocks.zh: 標籤混淆防止：標籤錯誤是藥廠最常見的召回原因之一。QRM 分析標籤系統的失誤點（如手動換標、不同規格標籤外觀相似），設計防呆（Poka-yoke）機制，如視覺驗證系統、條碼確認、實體隔離程序。
blocks.en: Preventing labeling mix-ups: labeling errors are among the most common causes of recalls. QRM analyzes failure points in the labeling system (such as manual label changeover and look-alike labels for different strengths) and designs mistake-proofing (poka-yoke) controls such as visual verification systems, barcode confirmation and physical segregation procedures.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析：II.9 供應鏈控制（Q9(R1) 新增章節）
blocks.en: Core Concepts: II.9 Supply Chain Control (New Section in Q9(R1))

blocks.zh: II.9 是 Q9(R1) 相較於原版 Q9 最重要的新增內容，直接回應 COVID-19 疫情揭示的全球藥品供應鏈脆弱性。其核心邏輯是：
blocks.en: II.9 is the most important new content in Q9(R1) compared with the original Q9, a direct response to the fragility of the global pharmaceutical supply chain exposed by COVID-19. Its core logic is:

blocks.zh: 三大應用主題：
blocks.en: Three application themes:

blocks.zh: 製程變異與管制狀態：製程漂移（drift）和非均勻性是供貨不穩定的內部根源，需要監控系統及早預警，避免演變成重大缺陷或召回
blocks.en: Process variability and state of control: process drift and non-uniformity are internal root causes of unstable supply. Monitoring systems are needed to give early warning before they develop into major defects or recalls

blocks.zh: 廠房設備可靠性：設備故障是最常見的供貨中斷原因之一；維護程序、備品庫存、設備設計的防人為失誤（防呆），都是降低此風險的手段
blocks.en: Reliability of facilities and equipment: equipment failure is one of the most common causes of supply interruption. Maintenance programs, spare-parts inventory and equipment design that guards against human error (mistake-proofing) are all ways to reduce this risk

blocks.zh: 供應商監督：當外部供應商的物料品質出現實質性波動，應強化審查——這直接對應 ICH Q10 Section 2.7 的供應商管理要求
blocks.en: Supplier oversight: when the quality of materials from an external supplier shows substantive fluctuation, review should be strengthened. This corresponds directly to the supplier management requirements in ICH Q10 Section 2.7

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：II.9 供應鏈 QRM 的後疫情意義
blocks.en: Analogy: The Post-Pandemic Significance of II.9 Supply Chain QRM

blocks.zh: 2020-2022 年的 COVID-19 疫情揭示了藥品供應鏈三個關鍵脆弱點：
blocks.en: The COVID-19 pandemic of 2020-2022 exposed three critical vulnerabilities in the pharmaceutical supply chain:

blocks.zh: 單一來源 API 風險：許多關鍵 API（如布洛芬、阿莫西林）高度集中於印度/中國少數幾家廠商。一旦那些廠停產，全球藥品短缺
blocks.en: Single-source API risk: many key APIs (such as ibuprofen and amoxicillin) are concentrated in a handful of manufacturers in India and China. If those sites stop production, drug shortages follow worldwide

blocks.zh: 地緣政治風險：出口禁令、海關延誤、運輸瓶頸
blocks.en: Geopolitical risk: export bans, customs delays and transport bottlenecks

blocks.zh: CDMO 集中風險：許多藥廠的商業化生產委外給少數 CDMO，CDMO 的品質或供應問題直接影響產品上市
blocks.en: CDMO concentration risk: many pharmaceutical companies outsource commercial production to a small number of CDMOs, so a CDMO's quality or supply problem directly affects product availability

blocks.zh: II.9 要求藥廠用 QRM 的方法量化和排序這些風險，並制定緩解計畫（如雙源供應策略 Dual-Source Strategy、安全庫存水位、替代製造地點預先確效）。這不只是 GMP 合規，更是企業經營韌性（Business Resilience）的要求。
blocks.en: II.9 expects pharmaceutical companies to use QRM to quantify and rank these risks and to establish mitigation plans (such as a Dual-Source Strategy, safety stock levels and pre-qualified alternative manufacturing sites). This is not just GMP compliance, but a requirement for Business Resilience.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：單一來源供應商風險（Single-Source Risk）
blocks.en: Key Note: Single-Source Supplier Risk

blocks.zh: 這是 II.9 中最重要的實務應用之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important practical applications in II.9:

blocks.zh: 識別：建立供應商清單，標注哪些原料只有單一核准來源（Sole-Qualified Supplier）
blocks.en: Identify: build a supplier list and flag which materials have only one approved source (Sole-Qualified Supplier)

blocks.zh: 評估：結合該供應商的：供貨量佔全球市場比例、歷史合規記錄、地理集中風險、財務穩定性
blocks.en: Assess: combine the supplier's share of the global market supply, compliance history, geographic concentration risk and financial stability

blocks.zh: 控制選項
blocks.en: Control options

blocks.zh: 雙源策略（Dual Sourcing）：預先核准第二供應商，即使平時不採購
blocks.en: Dual Sourcing: pre-approve a second supplier, even if it is not purchased from in normal times

blocks.zh: 戰略庫存（Strategic Stock）：維持 6-12 個月的安全庫存
blocks.en: Strategic Stock: maintain a safety stock of 6-12 months

blocks.zh: 技術轉移預案（Technology Transfer Contingency）：預先準備備用廠的技術轉移文件包
blocks.en: Technology Transfer Contingency: prepare in advance a technology transfer document package for a backup site

blocks.zh: 溝通：ICH Q9(R1) 鼓勵業界與法規機關就高風險供應情境提前溝通，法規機關可提供加速審查管道
blocks.en: Communicate: ICH Q9(R1) encourages industry to communicate with regulators early about high-risk supply situations, and regulators may offer expedited review pathways

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：II.9 供應鏈風險
blocks.en: CDMO in Practice: II.9 Supply Chain Risk

blocks.zh: CDMO 在供應鏈中的特殊地位（見下圖）：
blocks.en: The CDMO's special position in the supply chain (see the figure below):

blocks.zh: CDMO 是客戶的「關鍵供應商」：從客戶角度，CDMO 本身就是供應鏈的高風險節點（特別是單一 CDMO 策略）。客戶應對 CDMO 做供應鏈風險評估，評估廠房備援、關鍵設備備品、技術轉移能力。
blocks.en: The CDMO is a "critical supplier" to the client: from the client's perspective, the CDMO is itself a high-risk node in the supply chain (especially under a single-CDMO strategy). Clients should perform a supply chain risk assessment of the CDMO, covering facility redundancy, critical equipment spares and technology transfer capability.

blocks.zh: CDMO 對自身原料供應商的管理：CDMO 需要管理 API 原料、輔料、包材的供應商——這些風險若不受控，直接影響 CDMO 對客戶的交貨承諾。
blocks.en: The CDMO's management of its own raw material suppliers: a CDMO must manage suppliers of API, excipients and packaging materials. If these risks are not controlled, they directly affect the CDMO's delivery commitments to clients.

blocks.zh: II.9 對 CDMO 的商業機會：能夠提供供應鏈風險評估服務（如雙源供應計畫、備用廠技術轉移）的 CDMO，在後疫情時代具有額外的競爭優勢。尤其對依賴單一地點生產的客戶，CDMO 網絡（多地點生產）本身就是供應鏈韌性的解決方案。
blocks.en: The business opportunity of II.9 for CDMOs: a CDMO that can offer supply chain risk assessment services (such as dual-source plans and backup-site technology transfer) has an added competitive advantage in the post-pandemic era. For clients that depend on a single production site in particular, a CDMO network (multi-site manufacturing) is itself a supply chain resilience solution.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: （II.2 法規稽查） 一家無菌注射劑廠在過去 3 年內有 2 次自願召回（Class II），但合規計畫已執行完畢。根據 Annex II.1 的稽核風險因素，這家廠未來被 FDA 查廠的頻率和深度會比一般廠如何？他們應如何展示 QRM 的改善成效？
blocks.en: (II.2 Regulatory Operations) A sterile injectable site had two voluntary recalls (Class II) in the past 3 years, but the compliance program has been completed. Based on the audit risk factors in Annex II.1, how will the frequency and depth of future FDA inspections of this site compare with an average site? How should they demonstrate the improvement in their QRM?

blocks.zh: （II.4 廠房設計） 一家 CDMO 正在設計新的多產品無菌製劑廠，考慮使用 Isolator 技術替代傳統 Grade A/B 潔淨室。請用 QRM 框架列出支持和反對 Isolator 方案的風險因素，並說明如何做最終決策。
blocks.en: (II.4 Facility Design) A CDMO is designing a new multi-product sterile manufacturing facility and is considering isolator technology in place of a conventional Grade A/B cleanroom. Using the QRM framework, list the risk factors for and against the isolator option, and explain how the final decision should be made.

blocks.zh: （II.7 OOS 調查） 一批 API 的含量測定結果為 97.2%，規格為 98.0-102.0%。實驗室做了一次重測，結果為 99.1%。如何用 QRM（Ishikawa 魚骨圖）系統性地調查這個 OOS，以決定是否可以廢棄原始數據並接受重測結果？
blocks.en: (II.7 OOS Investigation) The assay result for a batch of API is 97.2%, against a specification of 98.0-102.0%. The laboratory ran one retest and obtained 99.1%. How would you use QRM (an Ishikawa diagram) to investigate this OOS systematically, in order to decide whether the original data can be invalidated and the retest result accepted?

blocks.zh: （II.9 供應鏈） 一家藥廠的某注射劑產品，其 API 只有一家核准的印度供應商，且該廠因 FDA 警告函目前受限生產。請用 Risk Ranking & Filtering 的概念，列出評估此單一來源風險的主要因素，並提出 3 個可行的風險緩解策略（短期/中期/長期）。
blocks.en: (II.9 Supply Chain) An injectable product's API has only one approved supplier, located in India, and that site is currently restricted in production because of an FDA warning letter. Using the concept of Risk Ranking & Filtering, list the main factors for assessing this single-source risk, and propose 3 feasible risk mitigation strategies (short-term, medium-term and long-term).

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Annex II
blocks.en: Section Summary — Annex II

blocks.zh: Annex II 的定位：QRM 應用示例（非新增要求），涵蓋製藥企業和法規機關各類操作的 9 大領域
blocks.en: Position of Annex II: examples of QRM applications (not new requirements), covering nine areas that span the operations of both pharmaceutical companies and regulators

blocks.zh: II.1 整合性品質管理：文件、培訓、偏差/OOS/投訴評估、稽核頻率、變更控制影響評估、持續改善——品質系統每個決策節點都應有 QRM 依據
blocks.en: II.1 Integrated Quality Management: documentation, training, evaluation of deviations/OOS/complaints, audit frequency, change control impact assessment and continual improvement. Every decision point in the quality system should be backed by QRM

blocks.zh: II.2 法規作業：法規機關用 QRM 規劃風險導向查廠（risk-based inspections），評估送審文件的科學充分性；強健的 QRM 體系可降低廠商被查廠的頻率
blocks.en: II.2 Regulatory Operations: regulators use QRM to plan risk-based inspections and to assess the scientific adequacy of submissions; a robust QRM system can reduce how often a company is inspected

blocks.zh: II.3 開發：QRM 支撐 CQA 識別、CPP 篩選、Design Space 建立，與 ICH Q8 緊密整合；CDMO 可作為協助客戶建立開發數據包的增值服務
blocks.en: II.3 Development: QRM supports CQA identification, CPP screening and Design Space establishment, and is closely integrated with ICH Q8; helping clients build a development data package is a value-added service a CDMO can offer

blocks.zh: II.4 廠房設備：風險導向確效（Risk-Based Qualification）決定 IQ/OQ/PQ 深度；清潔驗證限度應基於 HBEL 的科學方法，而非固定的 0.1%/10ppm 標準
blocks.en: II.4 Facilities and Equipment: Risk-Based Qualification determines the depth of IQ/OQ/PQ; cleaning validation limits should be based on the scientific HBEL approach rather than a fixed 0.1%/10 ppm criterion

blocks.zh: II.5 物料管理：供應商分級評估、起始原料變異風險、冷鏈偏差評估——CDMO 同時扮演委託製造方（受稽核）和採購方（執行稽核）雙重角色
blocks.en: II.5 Materials Management: tiered supplier evaluation, variability risk of starting materials and assessment of cold chain excursions. A CDMO plays a dual role, as contract manufacturer (being audited) and as purchaser (conducting audits)

blocks.zh: II.6 生產：風險導向驗證、製程內管控頻率設計、PAT 引入的科學依據——CDMO 需建立跨產品適用的平台化驗證決策框架
blocks.en: II.6 Production: risk-based validation, design of in-process control frequency and the scientific basis for introducing PAT. A CDMO needs to build a platform-based validation decision framework that applies across products

blocks.zh: II.7 實驗室/穩定性：QRM 在 OOS 調查中提供根本原因識別的系統化方法；穩定性試驗設計本身就是風險決策
blocks.en: II.7 Laboratory/Stability: QRM gives OOS investigations a systematic method for root cause identification; stability study design is itself a risk decision

blocks.zh: II.8 包裝標籤：容器封閉系統相容性評估、標籤混淆的 FMEA 分析——標籤錯誤是最常見的召回原因，QRM 預防優先
blocks.en: II.8 Packaging and Labeling: compatibility assessment of the container closure system and FMEA of labeling mix-ups. Labeling errors are the most common cause of recalls, and QRM puts prevention first

blocks.zh: II.9 供應鏈控制（新增 R1）：後疫情時代最關鍵的新增章節——用 QRM 量化單一來源供應商風險、製程管制狀態監控、設備維護可靠性；雙源策略、戰略庫存、技術轉移預案是三大緩解工具；CDMO 在此領域既是風險節點也是韌性解決方案
blocks.en: II.9 Supply Chain Control (new in R1): the most important new section for the post-pandemic era. Use QRM to quantify single-source supplier risk, monitor process state of control and ensure equipment maintenance reliability; dual sourcing, strategic stock and technology transfer contingency are the three main mitigation tools; a CDMO is both a risk node and a resilience solution in this area
